Hi all — quick finance perspective: 

- We can approve Net45 for strategic partnerships without senior finance sign-off; Net60 requires Director-level approval and a business rationale (impact to cash runway). If StellarMetrics is strategic, please provide a one-paragraph rationale and expected quarterly spend to attach to the approval.
- Early-pay: Redwood is running an early-pay pilot. Current standard offer is 1% if paid within 15 days, or 2% if paid within 10 days for enterprise tier customers. The program has a packaging fee and needs legal signoff on discount language.
- PO creation: once onboarding docs + bank details + signed onboarding form are in NetSuite, we can issue PO within 3-5 business days. Invoices must have PO number + invoice line matching.
